from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import hashlib

src_path = Path('/inputs/report.html')
out_path = Path('/work/report.html')
src = src_path.read_bytes()
src.decode('utf-8')  # require valid UTF-8
closing = b'</head>'
assert src.count(closing) == 1, 'Expected exactly one literal closing head tag'
pos = src.index(closing)
insert = (b'<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).">\n'
          b'<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">')
out = src[:pos] + insert + src[pos:]
out.decode('utf-8')
out_path.write_bytes(out)

# Verify exact byte preservation outside the requested insertion.
actual = out_path.read_bytes()
assert actual == out
assert actual[:pos] == src[:pos]
assert actual[pos + len(insert):] == src[pos:]
assert len(actual) == len(src) + len(insert)

class MetaAudit(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.in_head = False
        self.closed_head = False
        self.target = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag.lower() == 'head':
            self.in_head = True
        if self.in_head and tag.lower() == 'meta':
            d = dict(attrs)
            if d.get('name') in {'description', 'robots'}:
                self.target.append((d.get('name'), attrs))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag.lower() == 'head':
            self.in_head = False
            self.closed_head = True

a = MetaAudit(); a.feed(actual.decode('utf-8')); a.close()
assert a.target == [
    ('description', [('name', 'description'), ('content', 'AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).')]),
    ('robots', [('name', 'robots'), ('content', 'noindex, nofollow')]),
]
assert actual[pos:pos+len(insert)] == insert
